Umbrius is the revered river god of the Ubangi River, a major tributary of the Congo River in Central Africa. He is depicted as a mighty and powerful deity, with a regal presence that commands respect and awe. He is often associated with fertility, abundance, and life-giving powers of the river, which plays a vital role in the local ecosystems and communities.
